programs.title: Phantom Signals
programs.desc: A Russian radio station has broadcast a signal nonstop since the Cold War, and no one knows why; experts use hi-tech methods to investigate what it is and what might happen if it ever stops.

programs.title: Strange Evidence
programs.desc: A bus in the Italian countryside is found spewing powerful jets of fire; experts consider whether the vehicle was being used as a type of weapon, or if the blaze was the result of the fuel that the bus used or the battery it ran on.

programs.title: Strange Evidence
programs.desc: A monk unveils what looks like the corpse of a mermaid; a note claims that the creature was caught in the 18th century; experts investigate the possibility that the strange figure was actually a hominid that evolved to live in the ocean.

programs.title: Strange Evidence
programs.desc: Two nighttime explorers find a figure skulking around in an open grave; experts consider whether this person could be a tombstone tourist, the unlucky victim of a drug cartel or simply a person looking for some shelter.

programs.title: Strange Evidence
programs.desc: A hunchbacked creature scurries out of the jungle in Costa Rica; experts consider if this could be the mythical beast known as La Mona, a person with a rare medical condition, or the result of a powerful drug known as the devil's breath.

programs.title: Strange Evidence
programs.sub_title: Naked Super Soldier in Washington D.C
programs.desc: In Washington D.C., a naked man chases after a car at superhuman speed; experts consider if the man could be the product of government attempts at creating a super soldier, or the failed result of a mind-control experiment.
